newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline rallies on late NYMEX recovery.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline rallies on late NYMEX recovery.

text.p: NWE gasoline rallied strongly on Monday morning in line with crude and a late recovery in U.S. markets on Friday, traders said.

Premium unleaded barges traded from $224.00 to $226.00 fob ARA, and regular moved at $218 fob ARA, both $10 above Friday. A Polish refiner was expected to buy a 20,000-tonne cargo of premium unleaded fob U.K. at a small premium to benchmark prices fob U.K. on Monday. Premium unleaded cargo offers were heard above $230 cif NWE.
